name: reporting_cycles_list
description: List the assessment cycles the caller can report on, newest first, with their status, opened / planned end / closed dates, framework and version range, and participant count. Admins see every cycle (scope: "mine" narrows to their own org subtree); a manager sees the cycles with someone from their subtree enrolled, and counts only that subtree. A listed id works with reporting_cycle_cohort, reporting_capability_attainment and reporting_evidence_coverage; reporting_feedback_export is for tenant admins only.
